meaning.en: now, then (opens the text)
the revered sage Jabali
the son of Pippalada, the student asking the questions
asked, questioned
the secret of the supreme reality
what is the true reality
who is the individual soul
what is a bound creature
who is the Lord
what is the way to liberation
well asked, a fine question
I will tell it exactly as I have known it
from where did you come to know this

verification.notes: Word-by-word gloss read against the verse's own Sanskrit; each entry is a plain-language meaning, not a grammatical parse.

meaning.en: from the six-faced one, Kartikeya
by him, from him
from where was it known
from Ishana, that is, from Shiva
how was it known from him
through devoted worship of him
revered teacher, lord
out of kindness, please
tell me everything along with its hidden meaning

verification.notes: Word-by-word gloss read against the verse's own Sanskrit; each entry is a plain-language meaning, not a grammatical parse.

meaning.en: he explained the whole truth
possessed by ego, wrapped up in "I"-ness
a soul caught up in worldly existence
that itself is a bound creature
all-knowing, omniscient
accomplished in the five great cosmic functions
the lord of all, the master, Pashupati, Lord of bound creatures
who are the bound creatures
individual souls are called bound creatures
because he is their master, he is called Pashupati

verification.notes: Word-by-word gloss read against the verse's own Sanskrit; each entry is a plain-language meaning, not a grammatical parse.

meaning.en: grass-eating ones
lacking judgment, without discernment
made to serve others, under another's command
put to work in farming and similar tasks
enduring every kind of hardship
meaning.hi: सभी प्रकार का दुःख सहने वाले

meaning.en: bound down by their own masters
cows and similar bound animals
the all-knowing Lord, Pashupati
by what means does this knowledge arise
meaning.hi: यह ज्ञान किस उपाय से उत्पन्न होता है

meaning.en: simply by wearing sacred ash

verification.notes: Word-by-word gloss read against the verse's own Sanskrit; each entry is a plain-language meaning, not a grammatical parse.

meaning.en: what exactly is the method
where all should it be worn
with the five Brahman mantras beginning with Sadyojata
meaning.hi: सद्योजात आदि पाँच ब्रह्म मंत्रों से

meaning.en: having gathered the sacred ash
the formula "Agni is ash", used to consecrate it
having consecrated with mantra
the formula beginning "Manastoka", used while lifting the ash
having lifted it up and mixed it with water
the formula invoking a threefold long life
on the head, forehead, chest and shoulders
meaning.hi: सिर, ललाट, वक्ष और कंधों पर

meaning.en: with the three-eyed one's mantras, one should draw three lines
meaning.hi: त्र्यंबक मंत्रों से तीन रेखाएँ बनाए

verification.notes: Word-by-word gloss read against the verse's own Sanskrit; each entry is a plain-language meaning, not a grammatical parse.

meaning.en: this sacred discipline connected with Shambhu (Shiva)
spoken of by Vedic teachers throughout all the Vedas
meaning.hi: सब वेदों में वेदवादियों द्वारा कहा गया

meaning.en: a seeker of liberation should practice it
so as not to be born again
Sanatkumara asked for the reasoning behind it
the three lines of wearing the tripundra
from the forehead to the eyes and to the point between the eyebrows
meaning.hi: ललाट से आँखों तक और भौहों के बीच तक

meaning.en: the first line stands for the household fire
the letter A, the quality of restless energy, the earthly realm
one's own self, the power of action
the Rig Veda, the morning offering, the deity Prajapati

verification.notes: Word-by-word gloss read against the verse's own Sanskrit; each entry is a plain-language meaning, not a grammatical parse.

meaning.en: the second line stands for the southern fire
the letter U, the quality of clarity and balance
the middle space between earth and sky, the inner self
the power of will
the Yajur Veda, the midday offering, the deity Vishnu
the third line stands for the fire of offerings
the letter M, the quality of heaviness and inertia, the heavenly realm
the supreme self, the power of knowledge
the Sama Veda, the evening offering, the deity Mahadeva
in this way, the tripundra is made with sacred ash
meaning.hi: इस प्रकार त्रिपुण्ड्र भस्म से बनाया जाता है

verification.notes: Word-by-word gloss read against the verse's own Sanskrit; each entry is a plain-language meaning, not a grammatical parse.

meaning.en: whoever understands this, the knowing one
whether a student, householder, forest-dweller, or renunciant
becomes purified of every serious and minor wrongdoing
meaning.hi: महापापों और उपपापों से शुद्ध हो जाता है

meaning.en: it is as though he has meditated on all the deities
meaning.hi: मानो उसने सब देवताओं का ध्यान किया हो

meaning.en: it is as though he has bathed at every sacred crossing place
meaning.hi: मानो उसने सब तीर्थों में स्नान किया हो

meaning.en: he becomes one who has chanted all of Shiva's mantras
meaning.hi: वह सब रुद्र मंत्रों का जप करने वाला बन जाता है

meaning.en: he does not return again, he is freed from rebirth
